title: After-tax attribution of ML signal combination: cross-country identification
primary_outcome: After-tax net return per month of a dollar-neutral long/short book, taxable US top bracket, HIFO lots, accrual accounting. Secondary: the same under each of the nine jurisdictions in alphacomb.tax.jurisdictions.
selection_rule: Within each cell, the configuration with the highest validation rank IC on the validation window of each walk-forward split. No selection across cells: every cell is reported. No selection on test-period or lockbox data.
lockbox_note: 2021-2025 is sealed behind ALPHACOMB_FREEZE_TAG and is opened exactly once, after the 1995-2020 results are written and this plan is closed. If the lockbox contradicts the development result, both are reported.
notes: Pre-registered BEFORE the real-data (C1-C6) confirmatory run. Written because running the inference layer on the synthetic results showed that at the realised trial count of 539 nothing survived deflation: the expected maximum Sharpe from a 539-trial no-skill search is 0.727 and our best was 0.695. A small N is only honest if it was fixed in advance, which is what this file is for. Anything fitted outside the grid below is EXPLORATORY and may never be reported as a confirmatory result.
